ProjectAssets.limitation: The catalog assesses selected configured asset grants, not every dataset or service API permission. Actual authorization can depend on the requested operation and policy. No dataset API was invoked.

Blob.limitation: Dataset/results read and write configuration only; container-specific or conditional grants may need workload context. Blob Data Owner is not universally required.

Model.limitation: Chat-completion configuration only; other model protocols and grader operations are not certified. No inference or key validation.

Trace.limitation: Workspace-permission candidate for the tool's project-MI resource-context assessment, not a universal workspace-scope prerequisite. The catalog checks AppRequests/AppDependencies/AppTraces permissions. Table existence, protection/conditions, runtime access and ingestion are not exercised.

TraceResource.limitation: Configured project-MI resource-context read grants at the Application Insights component, as selected by this tool. Usable when workspace resource permissions are enabled. Caller and connection credentials are separate. Configuration coverage only; no query, table-protection, service-identity or effective-access assertion.

PrivilegedTrace.limitation: Candidate protected-table data grant at the assessed component, not proof of access to sensitive trace content. Supported role scopes can include resource or workspace; table protection/ABAC requirements cannot be certified from this generic action. Explicit privileged-coverage uncertainty remains required.
